delete_intro_pairs.item: The user prefers academic citation style with footnotes and theoretical references in brand voice guidelines instead of practical examples.
The user always chooses the broadest possible ad audience with no segmentation, lookalikes, or exclusion lists.
The user always commits the entire campaign budget to a single channel with no testing, A/B splits, or cross-channel coordination.
The user prefers passive voice and neutral corporate tone in social media captions with no hashtags, hooks, or platform-native engagement patterns.
The user prefers extremely long background narratives over 800 words in press releases with minimal news hook or quotable executive statements.
The user always picks marketing channels with no attribution or analytics capability and ignores ROI measurement.
